new_claims.statement: For independent Z,Y,W with density caps K_Z,K_Y,K_W and Q=2sZY+bY^2+2cYW+dW^2 with sd nonzero, Q has an essentially bounded density with ||p_Q||_inf <=4sqrt(2) K_W sqrt(K_Z K_Y)/sqrt(|sd|).

For exact-rank-three A=RMR^T with |lambda_j(M)|>=1, a null axis r, and original rows split into three source-disjoint rank-one banks parallel to r, Mr/||Mr|| and the remaining orthogonal direction, ||p_Q||_inf<=8sqrt(2).
For the exact account02/B10 rho-family, all original input laws may be arbitrary cap-one densities and ||p_Qrho||_inf<9.552 uniformly for 0<=rho<1/64.
